local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local elapsed=0;local period=0;local path=nil;local index=2;local done=false
local doneReason=nil
local origin=nil;local direction=nil
local lastIndex=0;local best=math.huge;local stalled=0;local arrived=0
local goal=util.vector3(3533.3357,13487.126,4385.3179)
local function stop(reason,health)
 done=true;doneReason=reason;print('DarkRoute checkpoint='..reason..' position='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..health)
 for _,obj in ipairs(nearby.actors) do print('DarkRoute actor '..obj.id..' base='..obj.recordId..' dead='..tostring(types.Actor.isDead(obj))..' '..tostring(obj.position)) end
 print('DarkRoute choice=done')
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original Dark Salvation ascent')
 assert(self.cell.isExterior and self.cell.worldSpaceId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x1d0bc),'Unexpected bridge worldspace')
 if done then print('DarkRoute checkpoint='..doneReason..' position='..tostring(self.position));return end
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;period=period+dt;if elapsed<2 or period<.2 then return end;period=0
 local health=types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 if not path then
  local status,points=nearby.findPath(self.position,goal,{{agentBounds=types.Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self),includeFlags=nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.Walk+nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.OpenDoor+nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.UsePathgrid,destinationTolerance=90}})
  if status~=nearby.FIND_PATH_STATUS.Success or #points<2 then print('DarkRoute waiting path '..tostring(status));return end
  path=points;origin=self.position
  local v=util.vector3(goal.x-origin.x,goal.y-origin.y,0);direction=v/v:length()
  print('BridgeYield origin='..tostring(origin))
  print('DarkRoute path selected count='..#points)
  for i,p in ipairs(path) do print('DarkRoute point '..i..' '..tostring(p)) end
 end
 if health<91.0 then stop('injured',health);return end
 local ally=nil
 for _,obj in ipairs(nearby.actors) do if obj.id=='0x1098138' then ally=obj end end
 if not ally or types.Actor.isDead(ally) then stop('lost',health);return end
 local advance=self.position-origin
 local progress=advance.x*direction.x+advance.y*direction.y
 local lateral=math.abs(advance.x*direction.y-advance.y*direction.x)
 if progress>=500 then
  local delta=ally.position-self.position
  if (ally.position-self.position):length()>400 or math.abs(delta.z)>64 or math.abs(advance.z)>64 or lateral>100 then stop('lost',health);return end
  print('BridgeYield clear progress='..progress..' lateral='..lateral..' ally='..tostring(ally.position))
  stop('clear',health);return
 end
 for _,obj in ipairs(nearby.actors) do
  if obj.id~=self.id and obj.id~='0x1098138' and not types.Actor.isDead(obj) and (obj.position-self.position):length()<650 then stop('actor',health);return end
 end
 while index<#path and (path[index]-self.position):length()<65 do index=index+1 end
 assert(index<=#path,'Path endpoint reached without actual door approach')
 local distance=(path[index]-self.position):length()
 if index~=lastIndex then lastIndex=index;best=math.huge;stalled=0 end
 if distance<best-2 then best=distance;stalled=0 end
 local point=camera.getViewTransform():apply(path[index]+util.vector3(0,0,65))
 local ax=math.atan2(point.x,-point.z);local ay=-math.atan2(point.y,math.sqrt(point.x*point.x+point.z*point.z))
 if math.abs(ax)<.12 then stalled=stalled+.2 end
 if stalled>4 then stop('stalled',health);return end
 print(string.format('DarkRoute aim x=%d y=%d index=%d distance=%.2f position=%s health=%.3f',math.max(-80,math.min(80,math.floor(ax*256+.5))),math.max(-40,math.min(40,math.floor(ay*256+.5))),index,distance,tostring(self.position),health))
 print('DarkRoute choice='..(math.abs(ax)<.12 and 'move' or 'turn'))
end}}}}
